ablation: remove the momentum/trend confirmation and size only by positive 3-day Sharpe
allocation: positive-score normalization, hard 25% single-name cap, unused gross remains cash
cash_rule: no positive qualified score means cash; cap-induced unused gross is cash
contamination_notes: User-directed translation of already-observed public Q25 profile motifs. This is a family-refinement screen, not a fresh novelty campaign; 2023+ is excluded from selection.
cost_hypothesis: two-day score persistence plus 21-day risk scaling should reduce, not eliminate, short-horizon turnover
failure_mode: short-horizon quality is noise after ATR-linked turnover costs or duplicates existing momentum/trend cores
falsifier: invert the 7-day momentum confirmation while keeping the same risk allocator
portfolio_role: profile-translation control; not presumed independent alpha
primitive: Quantiacs daily crypto OHLCV and historical is_liquid only
rebalance: daily score update with predeclared persistence smoothing; no calendar exclusions
selection: automatic cross-sectional thresholds only; no asset symbols or manual identities
selection_objective: minimum research/dev Sharpe across 0.04/0.08/0.12 ATR cost; then worst drawdown, lower turnover, id
source_notes: Derived from user-supplied Q25 leaderboard/profile family patterns; parameters frozen before repository measurement.
stop_rule: screen only; no parameter repair after results. Fail if causal/integrity checks fail or development evidence is weak. Do not claim independent alpha without separate controls/originality work.
thesis: Three-day return quality has incremental value when confirmed by positive 7-day momentum and a 34-day trend, with slower volatility used only for risk scaling.
timing: completed daily bars only; trailing windows; no future shifts
universe: historical is_liquid == 1 for scores and weights; no hand-picked symbols
validation: 2023+ excluded from this screen; participant-specific correlation remains PENDING
